title: Las Vegas to LA Day Tour Santa Monica Beverly Hills Hollywood
blurb:
THE ULTIMATE EXPERIENCE OF LOS ANGELES

The BEST of L.A. in a day! Experience the California adventure: from LAS VEGAS to the glamour of the CITY OF ANGELS to capture the essence of the WEST COAST.

 - MOJAVE & RETRO: Check-out at dawn. Stopover at the PEGGY SUE’S DINER, immersion in 50’S AMERICA before joining the PACIFIC.

 SANTA MONICA PIER: Experience the magic of the ICONIC Pier marking the end of ROUTE 66. Between Ferris Wheel and beaches, the perfect spot to experience the FREEDOM of CALIFORNIA.

 - BEVERLY HILLS: Pose in front of the BEVERLY HILLS SIGN and walk RODEO DRIVE, luxury and decor of PRETTY WOMAN. Explore the scenery of GTA V, between PALM TREES and STARS villas.

 - SUNSET & HOLLYWOOD: Cross the SUNSET STRIP to the WALK OF FAME, the CHINESE TCL THEATRE and the DOLBY THEATRE, home of the OSCARS.

 - FINAL PANORAMA: Admire the SKYLINE with a 360° view of LOS ANGELES. Take a close look at the HOLLYWOOD SIGN.
